title: Stave snapshot inventory entry
description: Per-file row in the `snapshots[]` array of `stave snapshot inventory --format json`. Inventory produces a richer view than `stave snapshot plan` — it loads each observation, runs lightweight quality checks, and recommends one of keep/archive/delete/review. External tools consume this output and execute the action; Stave never modifies the filesystem itself.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the snapshot file on the host that produced the inventory.

asset_id.description: Stave's asset identifier extracted from the snapshot's first asset. Empty when the file could not be parsed.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp recorded inside the observation. Falls back to file modification time when the snapshot has no captured_at.

age.description: Compact human-readable age relative to generated_at — e.g. `34d`, `5h`, `2m`.

age_seconds.description: Age in seconds since captured_at. Use this rather than parsing `age`.

tier.description: Retention tier name. Currently always empty in inventory output — tier resolution lives in `stave snapshot plan`. The field is reserved on the contract so a future inventory pass can populate it.

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the observation file on disk.

asset_count.description: Number of assets recorded inside the observation.

schema_valid.description: True when the file parsed and carries a recognised obs.v0.1 / obs.v1 schema_version. False entries are forced to action=review so the operator inspects them before any external delete/archive command runs.

assessment_status.description: Whether this snapshot has been through a `stave apply` evaluation. `evaluated` when a corresponding output file is found, `pending` when no evaluation is on disk, `unknown` when the file itself could not be parsed.

quality_pass.description: True when the inventory's lightweight quality heuristics (asset count vs --min-asset-count) pass.

quality_warnings.description: Human-readable warnings produced by the inventory quality heuristics. Always an array (never null); empty when no warnings fire.

retention_eligible.description: True when the snapshot's age exceeds the inventory's --retention-days threshold.

action.description: Recommended action — derived from retention_eligible × quality_pass × assessment_status. `keep` for in-window pass, `archive` for past-window pass, `delete` for past-window fail, `review` for ambiguous or unrecognised entries.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the recommended action.
